pred_ddx.label: Giant Cell Tumor of the Tendon Sheath

Giant Cell Tumor of the Tendon Sheath: The patient presents with a slowly enlarging mass on the dorsal aspect of her right wrist, which is consistent with a giant cell tumor of the tendon sheath. The ultrasound findings of a well-defined, multilobulated, mildly echogenic swelling within the fourth extensor tendon compartment also support this diagnosis.
Pigmented Villonodular Synovitis: Although less likely, pigmented villonodular synovitis is another benign giant cell tumor that affects the synovial sheaths and could present with similar symptoms and ultrasound findings.
